body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Sharp unveiled its new audio docking system ''DK-A1'' for iPod during CES 2007. It enables users to play music directly from any iPod model while charging its battery simultaneously.
The DK-A1 features a full range speaker with side firing subwoofers that support deep bass sound and AM/FM digital tuner.
It is expected to be available in May for a MSRP of $229.99
